summary: North kerb runs along a loading dock wall; no room to stop.
reasons: Building and loading dock at the kerb
No clear ground beside the lane
Campus service road, not for parking

drivers.seclusion: No homes near, but glasshouses sit 2-10 m from the kerb and the chemical store 11 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb meets a building wall and loading area with only a thin verge; a van would sit in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Service traffic to the glasshouses and chemical store.
drivers.convention: No cars park along this side.

flags: Chemical store and loading dock on this side
sun_shade: Building shades the kerb in the morning; tree at the west end.
